content.overview: Section 14 lists contracts the court will not specifically enforce: substituted performance already taken, personal-service character, determinable contracts, and unsupervised continuous duty.
content.study: A determinable contract is the usual commercial defence. Personal service and building contracts often fail here. Readiness is 16, not 14.
